initial_causal_lock: Native original MATERIAL_ADJUSTMENT/h.id journal can have only account dimensions; BC adjustment facade records only ADJUSTMENT link. Existing923 captures header but can omit original journal and miss a journal-only change.

exact_retained_header_DDL.definition:
CREATE TABLE erp.material_adjustments (
    id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
    adjustment_number character varying(60) NOT NULL,
    reason_code character varying(30) NOT NULL,
    physical_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL,
    status character varying(20) DEFAULT 'DRAFT'::character varying NOT NULL,
    notes text,
    created_by uuid,
    created_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    location_id uuid,
    row_version bigint DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT material_adjustments_reason_code_check CHECK (((reason_code)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('PERSONAL_USE'::character varying)::text, ('INTERNAL_FACTORY_USE'::character varying)::text, ('SAMPLE'::character varying)::text, ('MAINTENANCE'::character varying)::text, ('GIVEAWAY'::character varying)::text, ('DAMAGE'::character varying)::text, ('LOSS'::character varying)::text, ('COUNT_CORRECTION'::character varying)::text, ('OTHER'::character varying)::text]))),
    CONSTRAINT material_adjustments_row_version_check CHECK ((row_version > 0)),
    CONSTRAINT material_adjustments_status_check CHECK (((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('DRAFT'::character varying)::text, ('POSTED'::character varying)::text, ('REVERSED'::character varying)::text])))
);
